How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for GIMS Scientist B Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.gims.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 29-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GIMS Scientist B (Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the GIMS Scientist B (Medical) recruitment is 29th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Scientist B (Medical) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS/BDS/B.V.Sc. & AH degree recognized by MCI/DCI/VCI respectively. Alternatively, a BDS/B.V.Sc degree with one year of experience is also acceptable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Scientist B (Medical) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Scientist B (Medical) post is 35 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Scientist B (Medical) role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 67,000 per month, along with House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Scientist B (Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Scientist B (Medical) post at the Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the GIMS Scientist B (Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 1180 for all categories, including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Scientist B (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Scientist B (Medical) post will be based on an interview. Shortlisted candidates will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is GIMS/2026/12.

faq.question: Q10. Where is GIMS located?
faq.answer: GIMS is located in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 201310.
